title: Law to let people sue AI companies for harm from misuse
summary: This bill would create a new legal right for people in New York City to sue AI companies when a third party misuses or maliciously uses their AI model and causes foreseeable harm, if the company failed to put in place reasonable safeguards. Lawsuits could seek damages, including punitive damages, injunctions and other remedies. The bill was introduced alongside several other AI-related measures considered at an October 5, 2026 Committee of the Whole oversight hearing.
